rules.statement: An informal partition, where co-owners assume exclusive possession of their shares, can lead to a prescriptive claim if such possession continues for more than 10 years.
rules.supporting_quote: "In relating this provision to the case of co-owners, it must be borne in mind that separate possession by an individual co-owner of part of the property in common ownership may, and often does, occur and continue for a considerable period, purely for reasons of convenience, and that in order to displace the title of the other co-owners, clear and strong evidence of possession exclusive of the other co-owners, and inconsistent with the continuation of the co-ownership is required."
